mission_05: FeatureUnion applies multiple transformers to the same input data in parallel and concatenates their outputs, enabling you to create rich feature representations from multiple perspectives. Unlike ColumnTransformer which processes different columns differently, FeatureUnion processes all columns through different transformation pipelines and combines the results. This is useful for creating ensembles of feature representations, such as combining raw features, polynomial expansions, and dimensionality-reduced features. Each branch of the FeatureUnion can capture different aspects of the data, and the concatenated output provides the final estimator with a comprehensive feature set. FeatureUnion is particularly powerful when different transformations capture complementary information, and it integrates seamlessly with sklearn pipelines for end-to-end workflows.
